title: Marking to the side to avoid another player's line
question: If your ball-marker is on another player's putting line on the green, what should you do?

choices.text: Leave it on their line and wait for your turn
Move your marker to the side by one or two putter head lengths
Pick up your ball and marker without replacing them
Mark it with any item, not just a marker

explanation: You should move your marker to the side by one or two putter head lengths to avoid interfering with the other player's line.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the putting green moving her marker to the side with her putter so it is off another player's line.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer on green moving marker to avoid another player's line.
